title: Pradeep Kumar Dubey
text: Pradeep Kumar Dubey  (Hindi: प्रदीप कुमार दुबे) is a Judicial officer and the Principal Secretary (HJS) of Uttar Pradesh Legislative Assembly. Dubey joined  Uttar Pradesh Judicial Services - PCS(J) in Aug 1987. Before taking charge as the principal secretary, he served as the legal adviser to the Governor of Uttar Pradesh.
